product.physics_authority: Unity PhysX through one manually stepped local PhysicsScene

central_principles: Everything deterministic that can be done deterministically should be done deterministically.
Use the simplest model that produces the required physical and game behavior.
One physical authority; PhysX determines realized motion.
Actual humanoid plus reference intent plus finite powered joints plus physical bar/contact.
Shared physical substrate is not a shared exercise model.
Scientific claims are proportional to evidence.
Recorded-state replay, immutable rule snapshots, and evidence-backed milestone terminus.

artifacts.title: Bench Press Product Specification
artifacts.description: The player will create a stable competition setup, receive the bar, lower it under control, hold it motionless on the chest, press through the sticking region and lock both arms. The lift must look recognizably human, respond to load, expose a readable grind, obey competition-style commands, and fail for physical or control reasons that can be explained after the attempt.

artifacts.title: Visual Quality Gates
artifacts.description: Automated tests cannot certify a believable human powerlifter. Every milestone therefore includes deterministic visual evidence reviewed against explicit gates. A green test suite with broken hands, feet, spine, bar, or camera is a fail.

artifacts.title: Sports-Science-Style Analysis

It converts recorded simulation state into well-defined kinematic, temporal, geometric, and modeled-control summaries. It is not a force-plate, motion-capture, musculoskeletal, clinical, or coaching-validation system.

It should not look like a robotics laboratory, medical simulator, debug mannequin, or mobile clicker.

Final lift coupling degrees of freedom and finite capacities.
Current IPF Technical Rules Book locators, equipment constants, ordering/tie/scoring rules.
Reference/minimum hardware, build backend, platform/store requirements.
Third-party asset, audio, font, and package license inventory.
Human playtest and owner visual acceptance.
